block.bearing.peculiar_bell.tooltip.summ: An ornamental _brass bell_. Something odd may happen if it sits right over _soul fire_...
block.bearing.haunted_bell.tooltip.summa: A _cursed bell_ that the restless spirits of the Nether cling to.
block.bearing.haunted_bell.tooltip.behav: Marks nearby _dark spots_ where _hostile mobs_ are able to spawn.
item.bearing.cardboard_armor.tooltip.sum: _Wearable_ cardboard that makes you look _sharp_ and stay _unseen_.
item.bearing.cardboard_sword.tooltip.sum: Thwack. A _nearly_ _harmless_ yet surprisingly effective weapon.
item.bearing.copper_backtank.tooltip.sum: A _tank_ you _wear on your back_ to carry compressed air.
item.bearing.copper_backtank.tooltip.beh: Feeds _compressed air_ to any gear that runs on it.
_Fills up_ with _compressed air_; faster rotation fills it quicker.
A _tank_ you _wear on your back_ to carry compressed air.
Feeds _compressed air_ to any gear that runs on it.
_Fills up_ with _compressed air_; faster rotation fills it quicker.
item.bearing.copper_diving_helmet.toolti: Paired with a _Backtank_, lets you _breathe underwater_ for a long while.
Grants _Water Breathing_ while slowly using up the Backtank's _air_.
item.bearing.netherite_diving_helmet.too: With a _Netherite Backtank_, shields you from _intense heat_, but only if your _legs and feet_ are also clad in _Netherite_.
Makes you immune to _fire_ and _lava_ while slowly using up the Backtank's _air_. You can also _see further_ inside lava
item.bearing.copper_diving_boots.tooltip: _Weighted boots_ for getting around on the sea floor more easily.
You _sink faster_ in liquids and can _walk_ and _jump_ while submerged. _Mechanical belts_ no longer carry you along.
item.bearing.netherite_diving_boots.tool: _Weighted boots_ for getting around on the sea floor, even at the bottom of a lava sea.
You _sink faster_ in liquids and can _walk_ and _jump_ while submerged. _Mechanical belts_ no longer carry you along.
item.bearing.extendo_grip.tooltip.summar: Lets you _reach much further_. Can draw _air_ from a _Backtank_ instead of wearing out
item.bearing.extendo_grip.tooltip.behavi: Items used with the _main hand_ get extra _reach_.
Spends the tank's _air_ in place of _durability_
item.bearing.potato_cannon.tooltip.summa: Fires vegetables from your own farm at your foes. Can draw _air_ from a _Backtank_ instead of wearing out
item.bearing.potato_cannon.tooltip.behav: _Fires_ any usable ammo found in your _inventory_.
Spends the tank's _air_ in place of _durability_
item.bearing.wand_of_symmetry.tooltip.su: While in any _hotbar slot_, _copies each block you place_ across its mirror.
item.bearing.wand_of_symmetry.tooltip.be: _Places_ or _moves_ the mirror. Use while _sneaking_ to open its _settings_
item.bearing.handheld_worldshaper.toolti: _Creative-only_ tool for _reshaping terrain_ at range and on a large scale.
Sets the _looked-at block_ as the shaper's _material_.
Uses the chosen _Brush_ and _Tool_ at that spot.
item.bearing.linked_controller.tooltip.s: Sends _Redstone Link_ frequencies from your hand, one for each of its _six_ _buttons_.
item.bearing.linked_controller.tooltip.b: _Turns the controller on or off_. While on, your _movement keys_ drive it instead of you.
Starts _binding_: press one of the _six keys_ to tie it to that _link's frequency_.
Mounts the controller on the lectern for quick use. (Sneak + right-click to take it back)
block.bearing.toolbox.tooltip.summary: Every engineer's trusty sidekick. Neatly _stores_ lots of items, up to _8 kinds_.
block.bearing.toolbox.tooltip.behaviour2: _Players nearby_ can hold the _Toolbox key_ to reach its items _from a distance_.
item.bearing.sand_paper.tooltip.summary: _Polishes and refines_ materials. A Deployer can automate the job.
item.bearing.sand_paper.tooltip.behaviou: Polishes the item in your _off-hand_, or one on the _ground_ that you are _aiming at_
item.bearing.tree_fertilizer.tooltip.sum: A potent mineral blend that lets _saplings grow_ where space is tight.
item.bearing.tree_fertilizer.tooltip.beh: Grows the tree _even if_ it lacks the _room it normally needs_
